name: What is the process for sewer water cleanup in a crawl space?

mainEntity.name: What is the process for sewer water cleanup in a crawl space?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cleanup process begins with a thorough assessment to identify the source and extent of contamination. This is followed by extraction of the water, removal of all contaminated materials, and deep cleaning with industrial-grade disinfectants. Specialized drying equipment is then used to eliminate all moisture. Finally, post-remediation testing ensures the area is free from pathogens and safe.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process involves assessment, water extraction, removal of contaminated materials, deep disinfection, thorough drying, and final testing to ensure safety.
